label: B25-EMIF-RESILIENCE
title: Complete in-flight EMIF abort, timeout and response-hold semantics
scope: Harden only the AXI4-to-Avalon EMIF adapter so every accepted transaction completes exactly once with OKAY or an error across in-flight calibration failure, EMIF-only reset and bounded backend stalls; preserve AXI response VALID under backpressure and prevent late responses from crossing reset/timeout epochs.
required_semantics: An accepted normal transaction receives exactly one B/R response even if cal_fail arrives in-flight; the response is an AXI error, not success.
EMIF-only reset cannot silently drop an outstanding CPU-side transaction while cpu_rst_n remains asserted.
Permanent Avalon waitrequest and missing readdatavalid terminate through a bounded, parameterized timeout and return an error.
Once BVALID/RVALID is asserted it and its payload/ID/RLAST remain stable until BREADY/RREADY, including a later calibration abort.
A late backend response after timeout/reset is drained or the link remains poisoned; it must never satisfy a new epoch request.
Reset values are documented; timeout/abort state does not fabricate an OKAY response or duplicate side effects.

validation.L1_SV: Extend lcvex_axi4_avalon_tb with in-flight cal_fail at issue/wait/response-backpressure points, EMIF-only reset, permanent waitrequest, missing readdatavalid, timeout plus late response, reset/re-arm and exactly-one response checks.
validation.L1_Cocotb: Update the existing test that currently treats no response after in-flight cal_fail as success; require a held DECERR and add bounded timeout/reset epoch cases.
validation.regression: Existing normal read/write, randomized CDC, payload stability, no-DDR-before-calibration and duplicate_response_count tests remain green.

acceptance: SV and Cocotb independently prove liveness/error and no-stale-response semantics without weakening assertions. T-037 parent reruns the affected L1 plus B25 SoC smoke before candidate freeze.

resource.local_policy: Use the task worktree and task-local TMPDIR/SIM_BUILD; if a run becomes heavy, acquire local through resource-lock. Never use system /tmp.

forbidden_regions: core, DDR bridge, cache, MMU, QEMU, QSF/SDC or platform clock changes
JTAG, GamePC, Quartus, assembler, SOF/JIC/EPCQ/Flash or board actions
unbounded wait accepted as success, suppressed assertions or skipped reference checks

result.status: accepted; owner SV/Cocotb and parent SV/Cocotb/SoC/static reruns pass
